steps.summary: A lattice iron tower with a pointed apex, painted in red and dark colors, with multiple tiers and a distinctive conical upper section
A river with water visible in the lower portion of the frame
A white river cruise boat or barge on the water with a cabin structure
Multi-story apartment or office buildings visible on both sides of the tower, and buildings across the river
Tall modern buildings visible in the distant right side of the frame
Dense green trees at the base of the tower structure, surrounding the lower levels
Overcast sky with gray and white clouds covering most of the upper portion
Riverbank quays or docks visible along the water's edge on the left side

e1 unmistakably depicts the Eiffel Tower's iron lattice structure with its distinctive tiers and conical apex, illuminated with lights. e2, e3, e8 show the Seine river with cruise boats and quays typical of the area near the tower. e4, e5 show Parisian buildings and the La Défense skyline in the distance to the right.
